title: Inventory Management overview

claims.claim: A UIN (Unique Inventory Number) is a system-generated identifier assigned to a single physical unit of a product at the moment it is received into inventory; no two units share a UIN.

checks.note: the receiving edge function (inventory-import-batches, used by Manual Receive and bulk receiving) would write a per-unit UIN

claims.finding: The hub tiles route to /inventory-management/product-batches/<category> (InventoryManagement.tsx). That receiving path writes inventory_product_batches_v2, which has no UIN column (types/supabase.ts inventory_product_batches_v2 Row: lot_number, tissue_id, hcpcs_code, q_code, quantity …). A per-unit UIN exists only on the legacy amniotic_inventory_items / biologics_inventory_items tables and legacy pages. inventory_product_catalog_v2 does carry a product-level uin column (one value per catalog product, not per unit); ActiveProducts.tsx:339 and UsedProducts.tsx:152 read it but never render it (UsedProducts.tsx:219 formatUIN is never called).
claims.proposed_text: Each received lot is stored as an inventory record with its lot number, expiration date and quantity; amniotic and biologic receipts also carry a tissue ID, size and HCPCS/Q code.

claims.claim: The UIN travels with the item and is scanned in the Procedures & Supplies section of the Visit Wizard to link the unit to a clinical encounter.

checks.note: a scan control would appear in Procedures & Supplies

claims.finding: Procedures & Supplies has a free-text "Box UID/UIN" input (ProcedureSuppliesVisit.tsx:5346-5363, placeholder "Enter Box UID/UIN") with no scan control and no lookup against inventory. Units are picked from stock in the Conservative Care & Interventions section's lot picker (ConservativeCareInterventionVisit.tsx), and deducted when sections are saved (VisitWizardV4.tsx updateInventoryBatchStatuses).
claims.proposed_text: Stock is picked by lot in the Visit Wizard's Conservative Care & Interventions section. For a graft, Procedures & Supplies also records the Box UID/UIN typed from the package.

claims.claim: When stock falls to or below the PAR level, the system surfaces a replenishment alert so a vendor_coordinator or admin can reorder before a stockout occurs.

checks.note: the in-stock Low Stock counter would be computed, not hard-coded
the nightly PAR job would be scheduled

claims.finding: The Active Inventory "Low Stock" tile is always 0: ActiveProducts.tsx:410 sets lowStock: 0 and nothing computes it. nightly-par-check reads legacy ${category}_par_levels tables (nightly-par-check/index.ts:68-70) and no cron or workflow schedules it. A PAR level can be entered on the product (AddEditProduct.tsx par_level), but no live alert fires from it.
claims.proposed_text: You can record a PAR level on a product. Medipyxis does not yet raise a replenishment alert when stock falls to it.

claims.claim: Product Catalog tile: master list of every product your organization has configured, with a Products tab and a Vendors tab; add products and edit SKU/HCPCS metadata here.
The hub has Amniotic / Advance Treatment, Biologics / Matrix, and Conservative Care Products tiles for receiving and management of those products.
Biologics / Matrix tile: receiving with HCPCS + manufacturer lot-format validation.

checks.note: validating a received lot against its format/suffix would compare the strings

claims.finding: Receiving requires an HCPCS/Q code for amniotic and biologics (ManualReceiveModal.tsx:402) but does not validate the lot's format. The catalog's Lot No. Suffix only makes a lot number required on bulk upload (BulkUploadOrderModal.tsx:1158-1183). The '-' + three digits format is enforced on the catalog suffix itself (AddEditProduct.tsx:159-166), not on received lots.
claims.proposed_text: Biologics / Matrix — receiving and management for biologic matrix products; each received unit needs an HCPCS/Q code, tissue ID, size, lot number and expiration date.

claims.claim: PRP tile: platelet-rich plasma kits. Ultrasonic Mist (UM) tile: ultrasonic mist therapy cartridges.
IVR Tracking tile: tracks IVR submissions, outcomes, and vendor responses.

checks.pattern: "Track and manage Inventory Vendor Requests (IVR) submissions, outcomes, and vendor responses",

claims.claim: Clinician Inventory View tile: a read-only, role-filtered view of what's available at a clinician's facility, without cost or AP data.

checks.pattern: New Product Request|Request More Inventory|title="Receive Item"
checks.note: a read-only view has no request or receive actions

claims.finding: The tile opens ProviderInventoryView ("My Inventory" / "Provider Inventory" for admins), the provider's own assigned stock. It is not read-only: it has New Product Request, Request More Inventory, and a Received button to accept transferred items (ProviderInventoryView.tsx:700, 900, 980-990). It shows no cost data.
claims.proposed_text: Clinician Inventory View — a clinician's own assigned stock ("My Inventory"), without cost data. Clinicians accept transferred items with Received and can request more inventory.

claims.claim: Accounts Payable tile: vendor invoice intake, matching, payments, and disputes.
Main Inventory tile: the facility's stock and fulfillment view for what is physically on hand.

checks.note: an on-hand view tile would link to an in-stock page

claims.finding: The Main Inventory tile is described as "Clinician Fulfillment Request queue for triage, ordering, and stock-based fulfillment" and links to /inventory/reorder-requests (InventoryManagement.tsx main-inventory-fulfillment card). On-hand stock is on each category tile's Active Inventory tab.
claims.proposed_text: Main Inventory — the clinician fulfillment request queue for triage, ordering, and stock-based fulfillment. On-hand stock is on each category tile's Active Inventory tab.

claims.claim: PRP and Ultrasonic Mist are their own categories alongside Amniotic, Biologics, and Conservative Care; like conservative products, they flow through the standard deduction pipeline and do not require IVR prior authorization.

checks.pattern: // Reuses the same lot-picker + inventory_deduct_batch_v2 path as

checks.note: IVR requests offer only Amniotic and Biologics

claims.claim: FDA HCT/P Recall Lookup is a lookup tool, not a hub tile, for checking received tissue products against FDA recall data.

checks.note: checking against FDA recall data would fetch FDA data

claims.finding: Recall Lookup does not read any FDA recall data. You type a lot number from a recall notice and it lists every application of that lot at your facilities (inventory-recall-lookup/index.ts:81 .eq("lot_number", lotNumber)). It is not a hub tile and nothing in the app links to it; it is reached only at /inventory-management/recall-lookup.
claims.proposed_text: FDA HCT/P Recall Lookup — a lookup tool, not a hub tile, at /inventory-management/recall-lookup. Enter the lot number from a recall notice to find every patient who received product from that lot.

claims.claim: Bulk operations — shipment logging, vendor receiving, manual receipt, and provider assignment — are on a single landing page.
A product is defined in Product Catalog with its SKU, HCPCS, and category.
A shipment is received through the appropriate category tile (Amniotic / Advance Treatment, Biologics / Matrix, Conservative Care Products, PRP, or Ultrasonic Mist), generating a UIN for each unit.

checks.note: the receiving edge function (inventory-import-batches, used by Manual Receive and bulk receiving) would write a per-unit UIN

claims.finding: Receiving through the five category tiles is live, but it does not generate UINs (see inv-ov-01).
claims.proposed_text: A shipment is received through the appropriate category tile (Amniotic / Advance Treatment, Biologics / Matrix, Conservative Care Products, PRP, or Ultrasonic Mist), creating inventory records with lot and expiration.

claims.claim: If a payer requires prior authorization for a graft, an IVR is tracked in IVR Tracking.
Received units appear in inventory and become selectable in the Visit Wizard's Procedures & Supplies section.

checks.note: selecting received stock in Procedures & Supplies would read inventory batches there

claims.finding: Procedures & Supplies does not read inventory. Received stock is selected in the Conservative Care & Interventions section (ConservativeCareInterventionVisit.tsx:718-745 reads inventory_product_batches_v2 and patient allocations).
claims.proposed_text: Received units appear in inventory and become selectable in the Visit Wizard's Conservative Care & Interventions section.

claims.claim: Vendor invoices for received shipments are handled in Accounts Payable.
